summary: Comprehensive testing of GymAxis Memberships Analytics Engine (iteration 169). All 36 backend tests passed. Frontend testing verified all 5 analytics sections: Overview (KPIs, revenue trend with forecast, pie chart, membership mix), Retention (4 segment cards, cohort matrix, churn-by-plan), Classes (7x24 heatmap, top/underperforming classes, instructor scorecards), Operations (KPIs, site comparison, alerts), AI Insights (executive brief, at-risk members table with AI reasons, CRM push). Regression tests passed for Memberships console tabs and Member portal.

minor.issue: Returns 500 instead of 403 when called with member token (member tokens lack organization_id in expected format)

seed_data_creation: Analytics seed data created via utils/memberships_analytics_seed.py - ~249 check-ins, ~96 past class occurrences, ~481 past bookings, 33+ payment transactions, 2 failed payments for mbr-oliver (at-risk test case)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 169 Analytics Engine testing complete. All endpoints verified: (1) GET /api/memberships/analytics/overview - returns kpis (mrr_gbp, arpu_gbp, active_members, net_growth, churn_pct, revenue_gbp, occupancy_pct), trend, revenue_forecast, revenue_by_product, membership_mix; (2) GET /api/memberships/analytics/retention - returns cohort_matrix, segments (highly_engaged/regular/at_risk/inactive), churn_by_plan, segment_members; (3) GET /api/memberships/analytics/classes - returns classes_ranked, underperforming, top_performing, instructors (with retention_impact & payout_gbp), heatmap (7x24 grid); (4) GET /api/memberships/analytics/operations - returns booking_conversion_pct, payment_success_pct, refund_pct, avg_fill_hours, site_comparison, alerts[]; (5) POST /api/memberships/analytics/ai-brief - returns brief with headline/narrative/actions (GPT-4o-mini or deterministic fallback); (6) GET /api/memberships/analytics/at-risk - returns ranked list with AI reason strings; (7) POST /api/memberships/analytics/crm-push - creates crm_contacts + crm_activities; (8) GET /api/memberships/analytics/export.csv - all 6 report types work; (9) GET /api/memberships/analytics/export.pdf - returns valid %PDF-1.3 file. Frontend: Analytics tab visible in sidebar, role switcher (Manager/Regional/Director) works, all 5 sub-sections render correctly with Recharts visualizations.
